## Evidence
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New behavior has a test or a measurement (or the docs say it is unmeasured)
- [ ] Anything that writes, flashes, executes, or fetches a model-chosen URL is approval-gated or guarded
- [ ] No vendor documents, proprietary code, prompts or tool descriptions were copied in
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
